name: Завоювання простору з темпом (2)
description: Gaining space is essential, but when combined with an attack or threat, it can be done with tempo. Gaining space with tempo means simultaneously improving your position and forcing your opponent to react. In this lesson, this means advancing a pawn while attacking a piece at the same time.

examples.text: Zwart pakt ruimte in het centrum en dwingt daarmee tegelijkertijd het witte paard naar een inactief veld.
White relieves the tension by advancing the d-pawn and attacking the black knight. This gains White space and increases control over the board.
